title: Why Google Is Linking Standard Search To Mandatory AI Tools
description:
Google is telling schools they can't have standard Search without also enabling generative AI. We’re breaking down what this means for your school's IT settings and why the company says it’s a technical necessity.

What we covered:
• Google to block Search access for schools that disable AI features
• Meta initiates $25 billion debt offering to accelerate AI infrastructure development
• Google DeepMind publishes agentic cheminformatics research using Google Antigravity

Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways.

Listener question: If your AI tool was suddenly bundled with features you didn't want, would you keep using it or switch?

What to watch tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules.

Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next.
